review_notes: Twelve short-check dispositions. No whole fiction or academic paper read; the Beatless publisher synopsis was sufficient to save a specific unresolved economy gap.
Unrelated ambient-music Beatless hits, fanfiction, speculative real-world AI extrapolation and an unneeded streaming-copy synopsis were discarded.
Sectoral output ratios, cyberized bodies and artificial companionship do not establish a population leisure census.
The 500 processed-candidate milestone is not the requested 500 researched-society milestone.
